title: Create Aeronautics French
description: This pack replaces the original translations of the Create Aeronautics mod with a French translation and is also compatible with the Create Track extension.
body:
This pack replaces the original translations of the **Create Aeronautics** mod with a **French** translation and is also compatible with the Create Track extension.
